process-noise ladder.  ONE KNOB differs: filter.process_noise.sat_code_bias_q.
12 h so that a >=4 h ignition cut still leaves 8 h of settled window: the CB
carry's measured step response is tau ~ 3.8 h, so leg A's 20-epoch arms are
ENTIRELY ignition and their cb variance factor reads 1.92 against the settled
13.0 — 'never verdict in ignition' applies to this carry more than to most.
WHY A LADDER AT ALL, given leg A showed q barely moves the census: the graded
question is not the census, it is the WIRE.  scripts/cb_structure_function.py
measures the emitted OSBs DRIFTING (log-log slope 0.99 over 30 s..19200 s,
0.64 cm/30 s between satellites, ~1-2 m of wander about their own trend over
8 h) in directions that include C1W-C1C, a hardware constant.  A looser carry
tracks that drift FASTER.  This ladder measures whether it does.
GRADE ON (pre-registered): cb_structure_function SF(30 s) and the log-log
slope on the settled window; the IF-pin null control (must stay ~0 in every
arm); the cb / rxcb / clk variance factors; post-fit sigma0_code; the closed-
loop consumer median/p95/worst.  Products are NOT expected byte-identical.
FRESH lineage; own paths; run alone (scripts/q3_ladder_run.ps1 serializes).
